name: get_operation
description:
Gets the latest state of a long-running operation (e.g., returned by 'generate_audit_report'). Use this to poll the operation returned by `generate_audit_report`.
Format: 'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/operationIds/{operation_id}'.
CRITICAL: For {location}, use the location specified by the user. If no location is specified, prompt the user to provide one. Do not use 'global'. The location must match the chosen regional endpoint (REP) region (for example, us-central1).
CRITICAL: The `generate_audit_report` tool returns operations with `/operations/` in the response. Ensure to replace `/operations/` with `/operationIds/` before calling this tool.

name.description: The name of the operation resource.
